## Description

What changed and why. Link the issue it addresses, for example `Refs #123`.

**Target branch: `develop`.** `main` only moves in a release. The maintainer may reimplement your change on `develop` and close this PR as superseded; you keep co-author credit. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or tool
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor, test or CI

## How it was tested

Run the validation commands listed in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and say what you ran and what you saw. If something could not be run, say so.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is one concern, and the docs it affects are updated
- [ ] A positive and a negative test cover new behaviour
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, budget data or machine-specific paths (see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md))
- [ ] No new dependency, or the reason is stated above
